summary: E2E test of the new Management role feature. 8 of the 9 scenarios PASS end-to-end. One CRITICAL frontend bug found that blocks the entire Management procurement primary-approval flow via UI: Procurement.jsx does not render any Review button for role='management' on requests in 'pending_management' / 'management_clarification' status, so a Management user can SEE the request in the Active Queue but cannot approve/reject/clarify it from the UI. Backend endpoint POST /procurement/{id}/mgmt-action works (already curl-verified by main agent). Also found a branding regression: /login and /reset-password screens still show 'Agrocorp Lite' (see screenshot); only the sidebar shows the new 'Management Dashboard / Stakeholder Console' copy. All other tested flows are green.

ui_bugs.issue: Review button is only rendered when user?.role === 'admin' && status ∈ [pending_admin, pending_clarification]. There is NO condition for user.role === 'management' && status ∈ [pending_management, management_clarification]. Result: a Management user on /procurement sees the row (proc-row-<id>) with pill 'Awaiting Management' but no Review button at all. The ActionDialog itself already correctly switches endpoint via isMgmt at line 205-206, so the fix is only the render condition + adding data-testid=`mgmt-review-<id>` as spec'd in the review request.

Branding regression: both screens still render 'Agrocorp Lite' logo + text. Task said login shows company logos and new 'Management Dashboard / Stakeholder Console' copy. Only Layout.jsx sidebar was updated. See screenshot captured during first-login reset flow.
ui_bugs.selector: login page header / reset-password page header

integration_issues.flow: Management PRIMARY approval of procurement (Site Manager -> Management -> Admin -> Accounts)
integration_issues.issue: Cannot be completed via UI because of the missing Review button above. Steps (a),(b),(c) blocked: Site Manager raise -> pending_management works; Management sees the request; but cannot approve/reject/clarify via UI. mgmt-action backend endpoint itself is fine per prior curl tests.

ActionDialog already handles endpoint switching.

Update /login (Login.jsx) and /reset-password (ResetPassword.jsx) branding: replace 'Agrocorp Lite' logo/wordmark with 'Management Dashboard' / 'Stakeholder Console' + company logos as required by the spec.
After UI fix, re-verify full mgmt approve -> pending_admin -> admin approve -> approved -> accounts issue PO chain via UI.

Login.jsx / ResetPassword.jsx branding not aligned with the rest of the app; consolidate branding constants to lib/auth.jsx (already has ROLE_LABELS + MGMT_SECTIONS).

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the mgmt Review-button bug: while adding the management role, the render condition on Procurement.jsx line 97 was written for admin only (`user?.role === 'admin' && ['pending_admin','pending_clarification'].includes(r.status)`). The developer added the ActionDialog isMgmt branch (line 205) that hits /mgmt-action for pending_management statuses, but forgot to expose an entry point (button) for the management role. Reproduction: login as mgmt user with procurement perm, navigate to /procurement — the row exists but no Review button. Mitigation: add a second render block gated on `user?.role === 'management' && ['pending_management','management_clarification'].includes(r.status)` with testid `mgmt-review-<request_id>`. Root cause of branding regression: Login.jsx and ResetPassword.jsx still hardcode 'Agrocorp Lite' logo/wordmark; only Layout.jsx was updated.
